effectSummary.ko: 찢어낸 상처가 출혈을 만들면 그 출혈의 총량이 20% 증가합니다. 피의 회수가 실제 잔여 출혈을 정산하면 해당 적을 1초 기절시킵니다. 시전당 최대 5명이며 보스에게는 제압 수치를 줍니다.
effectSummary.en: Increase new Raking Wound bleed totals by 20%. Blood Reclamation stuns each enemy whose remaining bleed it actually cashes out for 1s, up to 5 per cast; bosses receive stagger credit.

description.ko: 전방 3m·90도 안의 최대 5명에게 D50% 물리 피해와 4초간 총 D120% 출혈을 줍니다. 자신의 W09 출혈만 강한 잔여량으로 갱신합니다.
description.en: Hit up to 5 enemies in a 3m, 90-degree cone for D50% physical damage and D120% bleed over 4s. Refresh only the W09 ledger, keeping the greater remaining total.

description.ko: 4m 안의 최대 5명에게 D80% 물리 피해를 주고 자신의 W09 잔여 출혈만 100% 즉시 정산합니다. 정산 대상마다 최대 HP 1%, 시전당 최대 5%를 회복합니다. 세트·장비의 지속 피해는 소비하지 않습니다.
description.en: Deal D80% physical damage to up to 5 enemies within 4m and cash out 100% of only your W09 remaining bleed. Heal 1% maximum HP per cashed-out enemy, up to 5% per cast. Never consume set or item ledgers.

concept: A compact pair of claw-tipped warrior gauntlets, three short raking finger blades feeding into a closed dark-red wrist reservoir, broad blunt knuckle plate beneath. Worn iron and garnet metal seams; no gore, blood splash or detached effect.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LW42, Wound Reaper's Grasp, class Warrior, slot gloves or gauntlets.
Subject design: A compact pair of claw-tipped warrior gauntlets, three short raking finger blades feeding into a closed dark-red wrist reservoir, broad blunt knuckle plate beneath. Worn iron and garnet metal seams; no gore, blood splash or detached effect.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: Increase new Raking Wound bleed totals by 20%. Blood Reclamation stuns each enemy whose remaining bleed it actually cashes out for 1s, up to 5 per cast; bosses receive stagger credit.
Direct skill context: W09 Raking Wound — Hit up to 5 enemies in a 3m, 90-degree cone for D50% physical damage and D120% bleed over 4s. Refresh only the W09 ledger, keeping the greater remaining total.; W10 Blood Reclamation — Deal D80% physical damage to up to 5 enemies within 4m and cash out 100% of only your W09 remaining bleed. Heal 1% maximum HP per cashed-out enemy, up to 5% per cast. Never consume set or item ledgers.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: square native PNG with real transparent alpha; the built-in 1254 by 1254 output is accepted, and 1024 by 1024 is also accepted. Preserve native pixels and alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Aim to contain the entire subject, including all tips and chain, within the central 76% with generous transparent padding. No part may be clipped or missing. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
